records.name: Agnes Versebound
records.biography_en: Agnes blesses HyperNorm incident reports before the ink dries. She keeps a separate book for incidents that refuse to settle.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: Her book contained three corrections and a remarkably pointed amen.

records.name: Bruno Splitlog
records.biography_en: Bruno was employed to cut through red tape. The first office thanked him. The second asked for its door back.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: He has been asked to handle matters more delicately. He sharpened the smaller edge.

records.name: Felix Softnote
records.biography_en: Felix plays the anthem at HyperNorm ceremonies. The verse that gets the loudest applause is the one he was told to leave out.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: I heard the tune perfectly. It took me a week to realize he had changed the words.

records.name: Ada Fizzwell
records.biography_en: Ada was asked to distill reassurance for HyperNorm. Her best sample turned green whenever anyone was reassuring.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: The flask bubbled as we thanked her for her time.

records.name: Moss Knucklebell
records.biography_en: Moss brings back witnesses who were filed as unavailable. The hand is the only one that still remembers the meeting schedule.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: It rang twice. I had asked a yes-or-no question and received both.

records.name: Cal Clackwork
records.biography_en: Cal builds a claw to retrieve cards from narrow HyperNorm files. The prototype keeps selecting the wrong card with remarkable confidence.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: It pinched the corner of my report. The clerk called this a successful grip test.
